summary: Kei Kataoka is an Indology and philosophy scholar who earned his PhD from the University of Tokyo under Hiroshi Marui and studied at National Sanskrit University. He held positions at the University of Tokyo, Wolfson College, Oxford, and Kyushu University.
Kei Okusa is a Buddhist studies scholar who earned a doctorate in literature from Otani University, where he is attested as a faculty member in 2026.

Keiichi Miyamoto is an Indology and philosophy scholar who earned his bachelor's, master's, and doctoral degrees at the University of Tokyo, studying under Minoru Hara. He worked at Toho Kenkyukai and served on the faculty at Kokugakuin University from 1986.
Keiji Iwata was a scholar of religious studies who studied at Kyoto University. He held academic posts at Tokyo Institute of Technology and Otani University.

Keiji Nishitani was a philosopher and religious studies scholar who studied at Kyoto University and the University of Freiburg under Kitaro Nishida, Hajime Tanabe, and Martin Heidegger. He taught at Otani University and served as a professor at Kyoto University.

Keiki Nakayama is a Buddhist studies and Indology scholar who studied at Kyoto University. He held positions at Kyoto University, the Japan Society for the Promotion of Science, and the Göttingen Academy of Sciences and Humanities.

Keiki Yabuki was a scholar of Buddhist and religious studies who studied at Tohoku Gakuin University, Taisho University, and the University of Tokyo. He taught at Shukyo University, the University of Tokyo, and served as professor at Taisho University.

Keikyo Nakamikado is a Buddhist studies and Tibetology scholar. Nakamikado was affiliated with Bukkyo University as a research collaborator in 2003 and served as a researcher at the Chion'in Research Institute of Jodo Buddhism in 2015.
Keinin Hayashi is an Indology, Buddhist studies, and philosophy scholar who formerly lectured at Waseda University and has served as a full-time researcher at the Eastern Institute.

Keir Strickland is a scholar in history, archaeology, and Indology who completed a PhD at Durham University under Robin Coningham. He held academic posts at the University of the Highlands and Islands and La Trobe University.

Keishin Okamura was a Buddhist and religious studies scholar who studied at Kyoto University. He taught as an associate and visiting professor at Koyasan University and served as a professor at Kochi University.

Keisho Tsukamoto was an Indology and Buddhist studies scholar who earned his doctorate from Tohoku University. He served as dean of Buddhist studies at Rissho University, professor at Tohoku University, and president of Hosen Gakuen College.

Keith Dowman is a Tibetology and Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University and trained under traditional teachers including Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche and Dudjom Rinpoche. He held a post at Sonoma State University in 1973.

Keiya Noguchi is a Buddhist studies scholar who completed doctoral studies at Kyoto University. He has held teaching posts at Shuchiin University and Taisho University, where he directed the Institute for Comprehensive Studies of Buddhism around 2016.

Keizaburo Mizuno is a scholar of Japanese art history, archaeology, and Buddhist studies who studied at the University of Tokyo. He worked at the Tokyo National Museum, became professor emeritus at Tokyo Fine Arts School, and directed two art museums.

Kelsey Alise Seymour is a scholar of Sinology and Buddhist studies who earned a PhD at the University of Pennsylvania under Victor H. Mair and held a visiting predoctoral fellowship at the Max Planck Institute for the History of Science.
Kemu Jin was an Indology and linguistics scholar who held a post at Visva-Bharati University from 1941 to 1945 and became Professor of Sanskrit at Peking University in 1948.

Ken McLeod is a Buddhist studies and Tibetology specialist who earned an M.Sc. at the University of British Columbia and trained under teachers including Kalu Rinpoche. He was resident teacher at Kagyu Dongak Chuling and founded Unfettered Mind.
Kendall R. Marchman is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Sinology who studied under Mario Poceski and earned a PhD from the University of Florida in 2015.

Kengo Harimoto is an Indology and philosophy scholar who studied at Kyushu University and earned a PhD from the University of Pennsylvania under Wilhelm Halbfass. Harimoto has held posts at Mahidol University and the University of Naples "L'Orientale".
